analysis.rationale: Based on BabiMind evidence assessment: 1) No clear entry price identified despite extensive oil/commodity analysis; 2) Medium confidence (0.75) regime bullish but insufficient precision for trade; 3) Geopolitical risks present (Iran, Middle East tensions); 4) Mixed signals across factors (some Available, some Partial); 5) No specific trade setup with defined risk/reward; 6) Framework prioritizes capital preservation over forced entries. Per BabiMind protocol: 'Prefer NO TRADE / WAIT when evidence or risk/reward is inadequate.'
analysis.evidence_summary: Oil price analysis dominates news (70/70 items); graph shows bullish regime (score 1.0, confidence 0.75); factor coverage mixed (Available/Partial statuses); options data present but no clear trade signal; geopolitical tensions (Iran, Middle East) present throughout; no entry price or downside risk defined; money migration model shows 7 markets with no clear directional edge
analysis.entry_trigger: Defined entry price with volume confirmation & real-money flow
analysis.exit_trigger: Defined risk level with volume-based invalidation
analysis.invalidations: Price rises while real-money flow deteriorates; sales growth rolls over 2 consecutive releases; copper breaks down materially
